newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin goes to Kremlin to meet Russian PM.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin goes to Kremlin to meet Russian PM.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, who left hospital only on Monday after treatment for pneumonia, went to the Kremlin on Wednesday for talks with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, the presidential press service said.

Doctors had said earlier this week that they did not expect the 65-year-old president to return to the Kremlin so soon after spending 12 days in hospital. It was not immediately clear how long he would spend there.
"President Yeltsin arrived at the Kremlin at 11.30 this morning (0830 GMT)," a spokesman at the presidential press service said.
Yeltsin left Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital on Monday evening and went to a residence outside Moscow to complete his convalescence.
His latest illness, which laid him low just two weeks after he returned to the Kremlin following six months absence with heart problems, has revived questions about his ability to rule.
The State Duma, or lower house of parliament, was due later on Wednesday to consider whether to try to force Yeltsin to step down on health grounds.
